name: Grafana Skills
summary: Official Grafana Labs Agent Skills for Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Pyroscope, k6, and LGTM. Apache-2.0 pack in grafana/skills.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (Grafana Labs). The grafana/skills repository is Apache-2.0, not archived, and was pushed 2026-11-17. The pack is free to install; Grafana Cloud or self-hosted usage is separate and was not purchased. https://docs.grafana.com/skills 301s to https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/skills, which returned HTTP 404 on 2026-11-17, so those URLs are not used as docs or sources; documentation is the GitHub README. Documented installs were not executed: `npx skills add grafana/skills`, and Claude Code plugins including grafana-plugins, core, cloud, lgtm, app-sdk, k6, and datasources under @grafana-skills after adding the marketplace. The pack covers Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Pyroscope, k6, and LGTM. A related official MCP is already listed as grafana-mcp; this skills entry does not set mcp_endpoint. No signup or spend.
